evidence.observation: The final side and motion silhouettes replace the nearly horizontal underjaw shelf/steep throat turn with a restrained descending cambered arc into the forechest. Whole mass, low broad watchful head, high shoulders, round ears, staggered planted paws, back/rump and warm coat remain coherent. No added dewlap, visible attachment gap, new seam or broken support is evident at normal viewing size. Tiny inherited/transported triangle shading remains visible at extreme throat enlargement; it does not break the whole contour or read as an attachment seam at ordinary size. Imported triangulated topology and stylized fur remain approximate. 390px phone framing contains the whole asset but presents it small; no optimized mobile delivery or physical-device performance claim.
